pages.title: Durum Wheat
pages.text: $(thing)Durum Wheat$() ($(o)Triticum turgidum subsp. durum$()), grass family.

$(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 110 °C·d above 0 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1600 °C·d$(). Best near 24 °C; stops above 36 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -10 °C (-2 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-8 (tolerates 5.5-8.5). Roots 1.5 m. Some tolerance of wet soil.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 110, P 18, K 75 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 45 bu/ac (3 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Durum Wheat and Durum Wheat Seeds.
